text.autoconfig.smartautoreconnect.title: Smart Auto Reconnect
text.autoconfig.smartautoreconnect.optio: On (default): an involuntary disconnect (kick, timeout, connection loss) retries per the settings on the Retry Attempts tab. Direct-connect/server-list only, not Realms/LAN.
TOAST_ONLY: toasts only. TOAST_AND_BUTTON (default): also a Cancel button on the disconnect screen.
How many times to retry before giving up (default: 5).
Delay before the first reconnect attempt (default: 30).
Added to the delay before each subsequent attempt (default: 20, e.g. 30/50/70/90/110s for 5 attempts).
On (default): give up entirely once the threshold below is hit (reconnect-then-instant-kick usually means a client-side problem, not the server).
More than this many disconnects within the time window below triggers the safeguard (default: 4).
Rolling window the disconnect threshold above is counted over (default: 300 = 5 minutes).
